sentences.text: Naga Chaitanya Akkineni -LRB- born 23 November 1986 -RRB- is an Indian film actor who works in Telugu cinema .	Indian film	Indian film	Telugu cinema	Telugu cinema
He debuted in the 2009 film Josh , directed by newcomer Vasu Varma and produced by Dil Raju .	Josh	Josh (2009 film)	Dil Raju	Dil Raju
Prior to the release of his first film , he signed his second film with Indira Productions , which was to be directed by Gautham Menon .	Gautham Menon	Gautham Menon

Ye Maaya Chesave released in February 2010 with comparisons drawn to his father Akkineni Nagarjuna 's romantic film , Geethanjali .	Ye Maaya Chesave	Ye Maaya Chesave	Akkineni Nagarjuna	Akkineni Nagarjuna	Geethanjali	Geethanjali (1989 film)
His next movie was Sukumar 's 100 % Love co-starring Tamannaah .	Sukumar	Sukumar (director)
The movie was shortly followed by Dhada and Bejawada .	Dhada	Dhada (2011 film)	Bejawada	Bejawada (film)
Chaitanya also appeared in the movie Autonagar Surya .	Autonagar Surya	Autonagar Surya
In 2013 , he appeared in Thadaka .	Thadaka	Thadaka
The film Manam also featured other members of his family .	Manam	Manam (film)
He has also appeared in Oka Laila Kosam .	Oka Laila Kosam	Oka Laila Kosam
